summary: Implemented deterministic offline/paper replay for crypto numeric scoring, review, and paper-plan decisions across fixture-only historical-style cases. The replay computes paper-only win/loss/no-action results, simulated paper PnL, bad entries, and rejected bad cases.
limitations: Uses fixture replay cases only; no live markets, prices, or APIs are fetched.
Paper PnL is simulated from fixture resolution prices and paper plan entries only.
No runtime integration, prompt automation, credentials, wallet access, or new validation layer was added.
recommended_next_task: PMBOT-BRAIN-006-CRYPTO-NUMERIC-REPLAY-REPORTING: add aggregate replay reporting only if review needs presentation improvements.
